title: Animal Breeding and Livestock Improvement
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is used to determine the true breeding value of an animal especially males which are used extensively for propagation of best germplasm.
Newborn screening
Random sampling
Progeny testing in animal breeding
Allele
Progeny testing in animal breeding is used to determine the true breeding value of an animal especially males which are used extensively for propagation of best germplasm.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a short sequence of DNA that is complimentary to, and thus binds to, a DNA sequence of interest.
Probe
Meiosis
Allele
Newborn screening
A probe is a short sequence of DNA that is complimentary to, and thus binds to, a DNA sequence of interest.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a process by which a sire‟s genetic merit is measured through the performance of his progeny.
Progeny testing
Natural selection
Linkage mapping
SNP
Progeny testing is a process by which a sire‟s genetic merit is measured through the performance of his progeny.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the process that determines which individuals become parents, how many offspring they produce, and how long they remain in the breeding population.
Quantitative trait
Allele
Final goal
Selection
Selection is the process that determines which individuals become parents, how many offspring they produce, and how long they remain in the breeding population.

Fill in the blank: ______ means that we take a random sample of individuals from a population and then augment this sample by including all or a random sample of relatives up to a certain degree of relatedness.
Major gene
Random sampling
Allele
Progeny testing in animal breeding

Random sampling means that we take a random sample of individuals from a population and then augment this sample by including all or a random sample of relatives up to a certain degree of relatedness.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the situation between single and complete ascertainment.
Newborn screening
Final goal
Incomplete multiple ascertainment
Random sampling
Incomplete multiple ascertainment is the situation between single and complete ascertainment.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the traditional method for QTL mapping, it implies to generate simple crosses derived populations and to estimate marker-gene recombination frequencies.
Linkage mapping
Random sampling
Natural selection
Progeny testing in animal breeding
Linkage mapping is the traditional method for QTL mapping, it implies to generate simple crosses derived populations and to estimate marker-gene recombination frequencies.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a measurable phenotype emerging from genetic and environmental factors that is distributed in magnitude in a population rather than all or none.
Incomplete multiple ascertainment
Probe
Progeny testing
Quantitative trait
A quantitative trait is a measurable phenotype emerging from genetic and environmental factors that is distributed in magnitude in a population rather than all or none.
Fill in the blank: ______ is used just after birth to identify genetic disorders that can be treated early in life.
Incomplete multiple ascertainment
Diagnostic testing
Quantitative trait
Newborn screening
Newborn screening is used just after birth to identify genetic disorders that can be treated early in life.
Fill in the blank: ______ is used to identify or rule out a specific genetic or chromosomal condition.

Diagnostic testing
Diagnostic testing is used to identify or rule out a specific genetic or chromosomal condition.

fib: ______ is a gene with pronounced phenotype expression and characterizes common expression of oligogenic series, that is, a small number of genes that determine the same trait.
Major gene
Major gene is a gene with pronounced phenotype expression and characterizes common expression of oligogenic series, that is, a small number of genes that determine the same trait.
______ is defined by the number of repeats there are at the same location.
allele
An allele is defined by the number of repeats there are at the same location.
______ are used not just to generate genetic maps but also to locate the places of interest in those maps with its incidence in the expression of the trait.
Molecular markers
Molecular markers are used not just to generate genetic maps but also to locate the places of interest in those maps with its incidence in the expression of the trait.
______ is considered informative when effective recombinations are generated, sending information from one genetic pool to other genetic pool.
Meiosis
Meiosis is considered informative when effective recombinations are generated, sending information from one genetic pool to other genetic pool.
______ is the identification of DNA coding or not coding sequences responsible for QTL (QTL cloning).
final goal
The final goal is the identification of DNA coding or not coding sequences responsible for QTL (QTL cloning).
______ is a position at which two alternate bases occur at appreciable frequency.
SNP
A SNP is a position at which two alternate bases occur at appreciable frequency.
______ is the great evolutionary force that fuels genetic change in all living things.
Natural selection
Natural selection is the great evolutionary force that fuels genetic change in all living things.
______ is a powerful tool to detect major gene variation.
Complex segregation analysis
Complex segregation analysis is a powerful tool to detect major gene variation.
______ is a gene or DNA sequence with a known location on a chromosome and associated with a particular gene or trait.
molecular marker
A molecular marker is a gene or DNA sequence with a known location on a chromosome and associated with a particular gene or trait.
______ is a genetic locus in which allelic variation affects variation in the observed phenotype.
QTL
A QTL is a genetic locus in which allelic variation affects variation in the observed phenotype.
